about_the_game:
Talescape is a place to play interactive stories made by real people. Choose, explore, and shape scenes that react to you. From warm and hopeful to unsettling and strange, the tone comes first.

  • Discover story worlds built around mood, not algorithms

  • Make meaningful choices that change what you see and learn

  • Find new creators and follow the voices you trust

  • Create and publish your own interactive story without coding

  • Keep your work in your control, with a clear and fair split

Closed Beta – Starting March 2026

Talescape will enter a limited closed beta next month. This first phase is primarily for Bards who want to test the editor and publishing tools early. Access keys will be shared exclusively through the official Discord server.

What is Talescape?

Talescape is an interactive storytelling platform where you can play stories and create your own. Every story is written and shaped by human creators, with player choice at the center of the experience.

Talescape is where Visual Novels meet Point & Click adventures. If you want stories that feel personal, intentional, and emotionally clear, this is the space they are built for.

Stories on Talescape cover a wide emotional range, from comforting and quiet to unsettling and strange. Your choices do not just move the plot forward, they shape how the story feels and what stays with you.

Dream Types

Dream Types are Talescape’s way to describe the emotional tone of a story. They are not genres, tags, or content warnings. They are a promise about how a story wants to feel while you play it, so you can browse by mood and pick the kind of experience you want right now.

Daydream stories are light, warm, and forward looking. They tend to give you room to breathe, with choices that feel like small acts of care or courage. The feeling is hopeful, even when things get messy.

Nightmare stories lean into tension, unease, and the feeling that something is wrong. They are meant to unsettle, to raise questions, and to keep you alert. The tone can be harsh or intimate, but it is always deliberate.

Vision stories are surreal, abstract, or hard to pin down in a good way. They do not always explain themselves, and they do not need to. You explore meaning through mood, imagery, and the way choices reshape what you think is happening.

Echo stories are quiet, reflective, and memory driven. They focus on what remains after a moment passes: regret, tenderness, distance, longing. The choices often feel less like winning and more like understanding.

Dreamers and Bards

Talescape serves two kinds of people, and both belong here: the ones who want to get lost in stories, and the ones who want to craft them.

Dreamers

  • Browse stories by how they feel, not just what they are.

  • Make choices, follow threads, and uncover different outcomes.

  • Support the creators you like, and keep your library in one place.

Bards

  • Build interactive stories with a visual workflow designed for writers and small teams.

  • Test as you go, catch mistakes early, then publish updates when you are ready.

  • You stay the author, the platform handles distribution.

Editor and Creation Tools

The editor is visual and no code. You build scenes, choices, and outcomes by arranging story pieces instead of writing scripts.

Talescape is made for iteration. You can preview your story at any point, test different paths, and use built in validation to catch broken links, missing content, and release blockers before you publish.

When it is ready, publishing is a guided process. Your story becomes discoverable to Dreamers without turning your project into a technical puzzle.

Business Model and Fairness

Talescape is built to be sustainable without squeezing creators.

Bards keep ownership of their stories. Publishing gives the platform the right to host and distribute your work, but it does not take it away from you.

Revenue share is straightforward: the platform takes a small service fee, and the creator keeps the majority. The goal is a marketplace that can run long term, while rewarding the people who write the stories.

Talescape's Mission

Talescape is for people who still want stories with a human voice.

We believe there should be a place for both playing and creating. A space where worlds can be explored, and where personal stories can be shaped with care.

Talescape is developed by Aureola, an independent studio from Dortmund, Germany. Our goal is to protect a space where imagination can speak freely and responsibly, and where stories are meant to last, not be consumed and discarded.

content_descriptors.notes: Talescape itself contains no explicit or adult content. However, it allows user-generated stories created by independent authors (“Bards”). Some stories may include mature themes or imagery if properly labeled according to Talescape’s Content Guidelines. Such content is optional, community-moderated, and clearly marked for age-appropriate audiences.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio device
  • Additional Notes: Apple Silicon only. Intel Macs are not supported. Internet connection required for publishing, collaboration, and marketplace features.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 14 Sonoma or newer
  • Processor: Apple M2 or newer
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M-series GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio device
  • Additional Notes: Recommended screen resolution 1280x720 or higher.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel UHD or equivalent)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio device
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for publishing, collaboration, and updates.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ntegrated or dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio device
  • Additional Notes: Recommended screen resolution 1280×720 or higher.

short_description: Talescape is a world for storytellers and dreamers. Create interactive stories without coding, publish them across platforms, and explore tales that move you, make you think, and stay with you long after they end.
supported_languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese
